birth.conversion_note: standard date; born during consulship of L. Licinius Crassus and Q. Mucius Scaevola

death.conversion_note: standard date; suicide after Pompeian defeat at Thapsus

short_description_zh: 罗马共和国末期元老、斯多葛派哲学家、贵族派领袖。以廉洁正直著称，终身反对凯撒，乌提卡战败后自杀殉国。
short_description_en: Late Roman Republic senator, Stoic philosopher, and Optimate leader. Renowned for incorruptibility and principled opposition to Julius Caesar. Committed suicide at Utica after the Pompeian defeat.
